cache.title: Cache Settings
cache.description: The application can cache some frontend resources to improve performance and enable offline access. This page provides settings to manage cache.

availability.title: Cache Availability
availability.activeExplanation: The Service Worker is active. It can cache frontend resources.
availability.inactiveExplanation: The resources will not be cached because Service Worker is not active. Service Worker is a background script that runs in browser. It can cache frontend resources and serve them when application is offline. If it is not active, request will go into network directly, preventing application from working offline.
availability.fix1: If this is first time for you to use application, sit down and relax. The service worker is supposed to be installing in background. Try to wait for a while and check again.
availability.fix2: If you are browsing in Private mode (or Incognito mode), Service Worker may not be supported or may be cleared when you close window. Try using normal browsing mode instead.
availability.fix3: Try refreshing page. Sometimes Service Worker needs a page reload to complete installation process.
availability.fix4: Check if your browser supports Service Workers. Most modern browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge) support Service Workers, but make sure you're using an updated version.
availability.fix5: If you're using a corporate network or behind a firewall, check if Service Workers are being blocked. Some security settings may prevent Service Worker registration.
availability.fix6: Disable any browser extensions that might interfere with Service Workers, such as ad blockers or privacy extensions, then reload page.
